The contentions of MPPMCL have been rejected by the Commission in other petitions including order dated 21.9.2021 in Petition No. 326/TT/2020. As MPPMCL has not challenged the findings, the same have attained finality. In view of this, the pleas raised by MPPMCL are rejected.
